      "evidence": [
        "Line 160 copies the live MANIFEST.json unchanged; its current state is awaiting-researcher-approval.",
        "Lines 156-158 freeze only the protocol and set correction_approval to pending with a nonexistent receipt and null digest.",
        "The loader checks correction approval at scripts/inquiry_evaluation_manifest.py:121-143, then independently rejects a draft manifest at line 147.",
        "[INFERENCE] If corrected-approval handling is bypassed, a draft source manifest can still raise ValueError('manifest is not frozen'), satisfying the new assertion. The original message-specific assertion would reject that wrong failure.",

      "impact": "This individual negative test can pass for the wrong reason before freezing. This is a test-evidence gap, not a claim that the current loader accepts unapproved production measurements. Other receipt tests cover distinct receipt-content failures.",

Reuse the complete freeze-copy approach in test/inquiry_approval_receipt.py:28-52, supplying receipt_approvals(protocol). No production preflight or executable is required. Keep the exception-type assertion rather than restoring wording coupling."
